about_the_game:
The Silent Jungle

During a mission in the dense jungles of Vietnam, Stephen and his squad are ambushed by the North Vietnamese Army. Gravely wounded, he awakens alone, disoriented, and lost. A strange, eerie fog blankets the jungle, hiding the scars of brutal battles and whispering horrors of the past. As he searches for a way out, reality twists into a nightmare—visions of war’s cruelty, tortured souls, and his own haunted past consume him. The deeper he ventures, the more the jungle tightens its grip. Is there a way out, or has he already become part of its curse?

Survive the unforgiving jungles of Vietnam

Immerse yourself in a classic-inspired nightmare, with a top-down view and an unrelenting eerie atmosphere.

Do you have the courage to fight... or will you run?

With limited supplies and enemies lurking in the shadows, every shot counts. Ammo is scarce—it could be your salvation or your doom.

Uncover the horrors of war

Amid the blood-soaked battleground, fear is your only certainty. The jungle echoes with the cries of the fallen, and every shadow hides a story of pain, madness, and something far worse. Survival is not just about fighting the enemy—it's about facing the terror war leaves behind.

  • A top-down horror game with a tense and chilling atmosphere.

  • No guidance—you're on your own. Pay attention to dialogues, letters, notes—even items—and piece everything together yourself!

  • Monsters aren't your only threat—In this jungle, everything is your enemy.

  • Every move matters. Moving while shooting will throw off your aim, and relentless action will drain your strength. Fight wisely—or fall.

  • Descend into the war’s underground tunnels—every corner hides deadly traps and unseen dangers.

  • Will you face demons... or the darkness within yourself?  

WELCOME TO THE JUNGLE...

short_description: The Silent Jungle is a classic survival horror game set during the Vietnam War. After a brutal ambush, a lost American soldier must survive in a cursed jungle filled with lethal traps and haunting illusions. To escape, he must uncover its dark secrets and break the curse.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese
